name: Himenomiya Arisu
source:
The youngest Himenomiya sister. She calls her brother 'onii'. She worked very hard to learn to cook Takeya's favorite foods while he was away. She is now the best cook of all her sisters. She makes Takeya her pet and a pet must listen to its master.

[spoiler]When she becomes pregnant her breasts grow and she's not longer flat.[/spoiler]
